tasks.desc: Derive the functional-graph/token model and formula: answer C + closed nontrivial cycles, impossible only when a closed cycle exists and no spare label (image_count == 26).
Implement the complete Python solution with stdin/stdout and the formula above.
Verify samples and edge cases: S == T, inconsistent mapping, full-alphabet closed cycle (no spare), closed cycle with spare, non-closed cycle with incoming edge, multiple closed cycles.
Final review for O(N+26) complexity, cycle-detection correctness, and clean final code without hardcoded tests.

proposals: Implement the refined functional-graph counting approach: verify consistency, build the 26-node mapping, count nonfixed present letters, detect nontrivial cycles, count closed cycles via indegree, and reject only when a closed cycle exists while T uses all 26 letters.

Develop a constructive ordering or simulation to validate the count: choose a spare letter absent from T, process acyclic components in reverse topological order, resolve non-closed cycles using their incoming node, and rotate closed cycles using the spare; use this to test edge cases and confirm attainability.

Build a small-alphabet exhaustive search oracle, such as BFS or Dijkstra over canonical strings or partitions, for alphabets of size 3 to 6, generate random S and T, and compare the computed minimum against the formula to catch modeling mistakes.

Explore an algebraic transformation-monoid or rank-based reduction: view each operation as a map on the 26-letter set, use monotonicity of image size and cycle structure to derive lower bounds and reachability conditions, especially for the full-alphabet impossibility case.

Consider a shortest-path search over canonical partitions or mappings with strong lower-bound pruning as a fallback or proof aid for tiny alphabets; keep it separate from the production algorithm because the state space grows rapidly.
prev: Implement the complete Python solution using the derived formula: read N, S, and T; check that each S character maps to a single T character; compute C = number of present S letters c with target[c] != c; compute indeg from present sources; count closed directed cycles of length >= 2 (all vertices have indeg == 1); compute image_count = number of letters with indeg > 0; output -1 if closed_cycles > 0 and image_count == 26, otherwise C + closed_cycles. Run the four samples and basic edge cases to verify.
